title: Reconstitution judgment: two exposed held-out cases replaced, held-out batches completed
situation: At acceptance the lead reported its builder briefs named the held-out folder, against held-out examples' withholding by omission, and that held-out behavioral cases ran once each. The architect's check of the builders' records found one builder searched the held-out folder, surfacing the text of held-out agents 4 and delivery 2. The held-out recordings of agents 4 still model separate confirmers that 0086 retired, and so do some visible recordings.
decision: (1) Held-out agents 4 and delivery 2 were seen by a builder, so both become visible and the illustrator writes a cold replacement for each, on the same concepts. (2) Held-out behavioral cases run as 0088 and 0092 require, not once: smoke, then a parallel batch that stops at four passes or a first never-assertion violation; the replacements included. My earlier instruction to run them once was wrong. (3) Every recording and fixture of this cut, visible or held out, is consistent with 0086 and 0090: none models a separate confirmer or a golden that hands back example approval; each rebound recording is seen to fail where its clause should. (4) Builder briefs never name the held-out examples or where they live; a builder is kept from them by omission alone. Then both assayers judge again.
consequences: Acceptance waits for the replacements and the completed held-out batches; the cut's outcome reports the exposure and the replacement.
